sourceRepos: Create React TypeScript components for Nexus Alpha IDE: 1) PipelineSidebar with 8 progressive steps (Architect, Plan, Build, Review, Audit, Fix&Retest, Verify, Deploy) and Settings link. 2) DashboardView with live metrics gauges, activity feed, mission control agent cards, stat cards. 3) ToastContainer with 4-tier notifications (info/success/warning/error). 4) HeaderStatusBar with pipeline progress. 5) toastStore and pipelineProgressStore Zustand stores. Use Tailwind CSS v4, framer-motion, lucide-react, dark theme #0A0A0B.
